items.title: CM to open Huddle Global on Nov 12
items.description: Kerala CM V D Satheesan to inaugurate Huddle Global startup festival in Kovalam on Nov 12; 120+ investors, 4,000 startups, AI expo, Kera Fund.

items.title: T’puram gains ground as AI hub
items.description: India AI Centre of Excellence (CAIK) in Thiruvananthapuram draws 56 startup applications, 24 from outside Kerala, offering zero-equity, real-world AI testing.

items.title: Generative AI Hackathon to be held in Thiruvananthapuram on Saturday
items.description: Generative AI Hackathon 2026 in Thiruvananthapuram at Technopark on Saturday; registrations close Nov 5 with PDF project idea submission.

items.title: Use of legislative majority to curtail PACs’ powers improper: CM
items.description: Kerala CM V D Satheesan says legislatures can’t expunge CAG audit findings by majority vote; PACs urged to use AI, clear long-pending audits.

items.title: Keralam to tighten curbs on fake lottery sales online
items.description: Kerala to crack down on fake lottery ticket sales using AI and social media, enforcing 2024 rules banning online sales and warning of jail or fines.

items.description: US-based TN techie Sharath Subramanyam held for 200+ hoax bomb threats in Kerala since 2023; allegedly used AI to target airports, courts, hotels, temples.
